title: Arabia-Eurasia collision
summary: The Arabian plate collided with Eurasia along a zone from eastern Anatolia to the Zagros, and when it began is debated. Mouthereau (2011) places initiation between 35 and 20 million years ago, with collision at the Bitlis thrust zone in the early Miocene, about 20 Ma. Darin and Umhoefer (2022) argue it began by about 42 Ma in eastern Anatolia and reached the southeastern Zagros by 25 to 15 Ma.

uncertainty.note: Years are Ma counted back from the present. Mouthereau: initiation between 35 and 20 Ma, Bitlis c. 20 Ma. Darin and Umhoefer: soft collision by ca. 42 Ma in eastern Anatolia; central Zagros 35 to 25 Ma; southeastern Zagros 25 to 15 Ma; earlier estimates ranged from about 50 to 10 Ma.
